The Larridin Scout API exposes the metrics behind Larridin Scout: AI adoption, AI proficiency (fluency), AI tool inventory and policy enforcement, employee surveys, and workflow intelligence. All documented endpoints are read-only (GET) and return the standard Scout envelope `{ "success": true, "data": {...}, "query": {...} }`.
